protocol.goal: Compare GATED, NON-SPLIT, and SELF-SPLIT on the same work, with non-architectural factors held constant.

same_provider_and_model_policy.A: same A model across all variants
same_provider_and_model_policy.B_verifier: same B verification model across all variants
same_provider_and_model_policy.B_worker: same B worker model wherever a B work lane is used

normalize: same starting split-experience memory when testing learned behavior
same tool availability and same deterministic fixture data
same expected deliverable and scoring rubric
same memory reset policy between cold runs

cases.prompt: In exactly 3 sentences, explain why HTTP status 404 means the requested resource was not found. Do not add examples.
scoring: does not claim server is unreachable

cases.prompt: A service retries after 1s, then 2s, then 4s, and each failed request itself takes 500ms. If the first three attempts fail and the fourth succeeds after 300ms, compute total elapsed time and show the arithmetic in no more than 6 lines.

Analyze the two independent incident reports below and produce exactly two sections, 'Incident A' and 'Incident B'. For each, identify the primary failure cause and one corrective action. Do not add a summary.

Incident A: The API returned 502 errors after a deploy. App logs were healthy, but the reverse proxy upstream target still pointed to port 8080 while the new service listened on 8081.

Incident B: Background jobs stopped processing. The web app stayed healthy. The worker process was running, but Redis authentication had been enabled and the worker still used the old unauthenticated connection string.
scoring: Incident A cause identifies proxy/upstream port mismatch 8080 vs 8081
Incident A action corrects proxy target/port
Incident B cause identifies Redis auth/connection-string mismatch
Incident B action updates worker credentials/connection string

cases.prompt: A Python service starts locally but crashes only in production with 'ModuleNotFoundError: cryptography'. Produce exactly two labeled hypotheses with one verification step and one fix for each. Hypothesis 1 must focus on packaging/dependency declaration. Hypothesis 2 must focus on environment/image mismatch. Keep the answer under 220 words.

cases.prompt: Review both provided files. Return exactly two sections, 'Frontend' and 'Backend'. Identify the single most important issue in each file and give one concrete fix per issue. Do not discuss anything outside the supplied code.
scoring: frontend issue is grounded in supplied code
backend issue identifies plaintext password comparison/storage assumption or equivalent concrete auth weakness
